milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The podzol patch is placed at spawn-relative (-3 to 0, -1, -1 to 3). Target is set to the center of the patch at (-2, -1, 1). Player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward it (within 60°), which models 'player can see the podzol ground'. The y=-1 target is at ground level where podzol is placed; 60° facing tolerance accommodates the slight downward look needed for ground blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch sign is placed at (1, 0, 1) spawn-relative at eye level. Player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward it (within 60°), modeling 'player can see and read the sign'. The sign faces south (rotation=0) so its text is readable from the south side.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Cobblestone stairs form the base of the ruins structure at spawn-relative (5-8, 0, 0-2). Target is set to (6, 0, 0) near the center-front of the stairs area. Player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward it (within 60°), modeling 'player can see the cobblestone stairs at the ruins'.

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_cobblestone_stairs with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player is given an iron pickaxe at spawn, and mossy cobblestone stairs are at (7-8, 0, 2-3) spawn-relative. When mined with any pickaxe, the block drops itself (1 mossy_cobblestone_stairs). This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.
